issues.legal_issue: Growers whose accrued claim to an additional cane price may be removed by an exemption must be given an opportunity to be heard before the exemption is granted.
material_facts: An authority fixed additional prices payable to the growers for cane supplied during two seasons, and neither the producer nor the growers appealed that determination.
The producer sought a full or partial exemption on the ground that it had made inadequate profits.
The Government granted the exemption without giving the growers an opportunity to present their objections.
The growers’ claim to the additional price would be reduced or removed by the exemption.
issues.conclusion: The growers were entitled to be heard before the Government granted an exemption. Because they were not heard, the High Court was right to quash the exemption orders, and the appeals were dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Under clauses 5(1), 5(3), 5(4) and 5(5) of the Sugar Cane Control Order, 1966, the exemption power forms part of the scheme for determining and paying additional cane prices; it is not independent of the growers’ interest in payment. Natural justice requires an opportunity to be heard when the exercise of power may deprive a person of a legitimate interest or expectation. Whether a duty to act judicially arises depends on the nature of the interest affected, the circumstances of the power’s exercise and any sanctions involved. Clause 5(6), concerning the manner of payment, does not affect the growers’ interest in the additional price. No earlier cases are cited.

rule.if: exemption_request_proceeding and additional_price_fixed and growers_interest_would_be_removed and growers_not_heard

predicates.exemption_request_proceeding: A producer asked the government to reduce or waive an additional cane-price obligation on the ground that the producer had made inadequate profits.
predicates.additional_price_fixed: An authority fixed an additional amount payable to growers, and that determination became final.
predicates.growers_interest_would_be_removed: The requested exemption could reduce or remove the growers’ claim to the additional amount.
predicates.growers_not_heard: The government considered the exemption request without allowing the affected growers to present their views or objections.

issues.definition: When a producer seeks an exemption after an additional price has been fixed, the exemption may remove the growers’ interest in payment, and the growers are not heard, the exemption cannot stand without their hearing.
